title: Binance attacker XRPL wallet first independently corroborated outbound transfer; distribution-count reconciliation

independently_corroborated_outbound.validated_status: Whale Alert transaction record; direct XRPLScan page returned HTTP 403 during this run
independently_corroborated_outbound.source_lines: Opened page: timestamp, amount, hash, fee, sender and receiver are visible at lines 0-33.
independently_corroborated_outbound.valuation_note: Whale Alert page shows $50,456,669 in the headline and $50,489,135 in transfer details while stating $1.2622 XRP price. These USD fields are internally inconsistent; only the 40,000,000 XRP quantity is admitted as the measured amount.

prior_run_claims_requiring_reconciliatio.source: Previous research handoff, November 2, approximately 05:05 UTC; Bithomp transaction-history links were supplied but were inaccessible to the current web retrieval tool.
prior_run_claims_requiring_reconciliatio.reported_additional_activation_account: rJheAAx... (full address not independently captured in current run)
unresolved_internal_inconsistencies: The previous narrative says nine successful outgoing Payments, while the table contains six large-tranche rows.

The previous narrative also says six recipient accounts were activated with 1,000 XRP each and separately describes a seventh 1,000-XRP activation; these activation transfers are not reconciled to the stated nine-payment count.
The six displayed large-tranche rows sum to 233,454,920 XRP, which is 7,023.1 XRP below the original reported 233,461,943.1 XRP inflow.

The previous narrative described all six recipients as newly activated and showed no subsequent outgoing transactions, but those claims have not been independently re-fetched from raw validated-ledger history in this run.

confirmed_facts: The original attacker account received approximately 233.462 million XRP from five Binance-attributed source wallets on October 29, 2026, as documented by TRM/XRPL research.
A timestamped November 1, 20:00 UTC XRPLDashboard snapshot reported the original account still held 233,461,943.7 XRP with zero outbound transactions at that snapshot.
Whale Alert independently records one successful 40,000,000 XRP payment from the original attacker account to rhXtRtpfZRAKVayWd5Z5kRJ2YXYkcuxNRD at 2026-11-02T03:56:21Z.
inference: The confirmed 40M payment is consistent with the beginning of wallet segmentation or staged redistribution.
A transfer from the attacker account is not itself a spot sale, exchange deposit, DEX swap, bridge transfer or realized liquidation.
unknowns: Current validated-ledger balance of the original attacker account.
Whether the other five large tranches described in the prior run are all valid and complete.
Whether the reported 1,000-XRP activations were funded by the attacker account and how many successful activation payments occurred.
Whether any recipient has since sent XRP to an exchange, DEX, bridge, escrow or other intermediary.
Beneficial ownership and control of each recipient account.
Whether any of the transferred XRP has been sold or monetized off-ledger.
disconfirming_or_quality_flags: The November 1 snapshot is chronologically before the November 2 outbound payment and therefore does not contradict that later movement.
The prior handoff's 'nine successful payments' count conflicts with its six-row large-transfer table and activation narrative.
Whale Alert's USD valuations on the opened transaction page conflict internally; XRP quantity, not displayed USD value, is used.

competing_hypotheses.description: Attacker is segmenting stolen XRP into multiple wallets before later movement.
competing_hypotheses.support: One 40M outbound transfer to a previously unknown destination is independently recorded; prior Bithomp report alleges multiple tranches.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Only one outbound transaction was independently corroborated in this run; no exchange/DEX/bridge deposit or sale is established.

competing_hypotheses.description: The destination is an intermediate custody/staging wallet and funds may remain dormant.
competing_hypotheses.support: The verified payment is a direct wallet-to-wallet transfer; no sale is shown by the transaction record.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Subsequent destination-account history was not obtained.

competing_hypotheses.description: The transfers are intended to route funds toward exchange/DEX/bridge monetization.
competing_hypotheses.support: Wallet segmentation can precede laundering or conversion.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: No destination service attribution, swap, bridge event or exchange deposit is verified.

competing_hypotheses.description: The apparent multi-wallet distribution in the prior handoff contains a count or attribution error.
competing_hypotheses.support: The prior report's nine-payment count, six-row table and activation narrative do not reconcile; only one transaction was independently corroborated now.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Whale Alert confirms at least one of the reported 40M transfers.

market_interpretation.rationale: A wallet transfer changes custody/location, not necessarily market supply available for sale. No price-direction inference is justified from one transfer.

Query transaction hash 3AAA8BEE45ADFD6833A2CAED9E28D00F82C20278F730BA722B79DB453B0E617D through an independent public rippled/Clio node and verify tesSUCCESS, delivered_amount, ledger_index and close_time.

Reconcile all successful Payment transactions, activation payments, fees, reserves and final AccountRoot balances; explain every XRP difference before publishing a total.
